questions.q: Which system view reveals Redshift's specific reason for the COPY failure?
options: sys_load_error_detail
information_schema.columns
pg_stat_activity
svv_table_info
questions.explain: sys_load_error_detail is Redshift Serverless's own record of the specific reason behind recent failed load attempts.

questions.q: What does the error_message returned in this lesson indicate?
options: A malformed Parquet file in the curated zone
An S3 Access Denied–style error, pointing to a permissions problem
A typo in the fact_orders column list
The Redshift Serverless workgroup is out of capacity
questions.explain: The Access Denied–style message reframes the investigation away from data/format issues and toward permissions between Redshift and S3.

questions.q: Which permission is missing entirely from the northfield-redshift-copy-role's policy?
options: s3:GetObject on the object prefix
s3:ListBucket on the bucket itself
s3:PutObject on the raw zone
glue:StartJobRun on northfield-orders-etl
questions.explain: The policy only grants s3:GetObject on the orders/ prefix; it never includes an s3:ListBucket statement on the bucket ARN.

questions.q: Why does a role with GetObject but no ListBucket fail a COPY before reading a single file?
options: COPY must first list the bucket to enumerate which Parquet files exist under the prefix, before it can GetObject each one
GetObject alone is always sufficient; this is an unrelated failure
Redshift requires ListBucket only for CSV files, not Parquet
COPY reads files in a fixed, pre-known order and never needs to list anything
questions.explain: Glue writes a different set of part files each run, so COPY has no way to know what exists without first listing the bucket's contents.

questions.q: What does this lesson conclude, in terms of what gets done next?
options: The root cause is confirmed, but the fix itself happens in the next lesson, not this one
The policy is corrected immediately within this lesson
The entire IAM role is deleted and recreated from scratch
The curated zone is migrated to a new bucket to avoid the issue
questions.explain: This lesson's scope ends at confirming the root cause two ways (error detail plus policy review); fixing it is the next lesson's job.
